cost_application: sum(abs(diff(scaled_held_weight))) * cost_bps / 1e4, applied to the guard-scaled T1 book held-weight matrix (base book weights times the daily multiplier); the cash leg (SHY) carries no separate transaction cost, consistent with open_composer.research.signal_card.book_returns's own convention on the base book.

cash_leg.return_definition: next-open total return (open[t+1]/open[t]-1 on SHY's own adjusted open series), computed the same way as the book's own ret series (Market.next_open_returns) so both legs share one timing convention.
cash_leg.rationale: Matches scripts/run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py's CASH=SHY convention used elsewhere in this repo, rather than 0%; task text explicitly allows either and asks the choice to be stated.
